Klavier Gavin is the Devil: handsome, charismatic, deadly. At least, that's what everyone says - the dazzling rock star is heavily rumored to have murdered every defendant that wasn't declared guilty in his trials.
As soon as Apollo Justice actually meets the man, he has to assume that everyone is full of shit.
